rows.statement: Until Andre approves a V&I rule version, every ruling is negative with RULES_NOT_IN_FORCE.
rows.title: No ruling without an Andre-approved rule version

rows.statement: Counts come only from official platform APIs through an account the clipper connected with OAuth; no other count source is accepted.
rows.title: Official-API counts through the clipper's own OAuth connection only

rows.statement: V&I never scrapes platform pages and never downloads posted media.
rows.title: No scraping, no download of posted media

rows.statement: The certified count is the platform-returned value fetched in the settlement window, never substituted, smoothed, interpolated or computed.
rows.title: Certified count is the platform-returned value at settlement

rows.statement: A clip settles at the platform create time plus the larger of Compliance HR-13 settlement_lag_days and the rulebook's minimum live days; the lag is read from Compliance.
rows.title: Settle at create_time + max(HR-13 lag, rulebook minimum live days)

rows.statement: Any downward platform revision of a certified count before revision_watch_end records a revision and a clawback record (counts only); Finance decides recovery.
rows.title: Downward platform revision before revision_watch_end: revision and clawback record

rows.statement: The clip must be evidenced live on every day from posting through the rulebook minimum live period.
rows.title: Live every day through the rulebook's minimum live period

rows.statement: Same video id, same author and the per-platform fingerprint taken at approval.
rows.title: Posted clip is the approved clip

rows.statement: The caption/description hash must equal the one taken at approval (disclosure lives in the caption).
rows.title: Caption unchanged since approval

rows.statement: The engagement anomaly screen may open a hold for a human; it never decides payment and never releases its own hold.
rows.title: Anomaly screen may hold; never decides pay

rows.statement: Upheld bought/botted engagement or platform stripping at or above the threshold is an S3 strike and voids the clip.
rows.title: Bought or botted engagement: S3 strike, clip voided

rows.statement: Clippers are 18+: neutral DOB field plus one highly effective age-assurance method; self-declaration never passes; there is no guardian path.
rows.title: 18+ via neutral DOB plus one highly effective method; no guardian path

rows.statement: A clipper has exactly one identity: one email and one payout identity.
rows.title: One identity: one email, one payout identity

rows.statement: A connected social account belongs to exactly one clipper identity; sharing or renting is forbidden.
rows.title: A social account belongs to exactly one identity

rows.statement: A submitted clip matching another clipper's clip or a campaign seed clip is held for a human decision.
rows.title: Match to another clipper's clip or a campaign seed: hold to a human

rows.statement: Platform data is kept only as §B.5 allows (VI-15a..e); YouTube derived signals and cross-clipper aggregation stay off pending counsel question VI-CQ-01.
rows.title: Platform-data retention per platform; YouTube derived and aggregated use off

rows.statement: YouTube statistics and YouTube Analytics API data may be stored as long as the certification record is kept (VI_EVIDENCE_RETENTION_DAYS).
rows.title: YouTube statistics and Analytics data: kept with the certification record

rows.statement: Other YouTube Authorized Data is refreshed or deleted within 30 calendar days of fetch, kept only as SHA-256 after revision_watch_end, and deleted within 24 hours of a revoked connection.
rows.title: YouTube other Authorized Data: 30-day refresh-or-delete; revoked connection purged in 24 h

rows.statement: TikTok counts kept as YouTube statistics; id, create_time, share_url, duration and description 30-day refresh-or-delete; cover_image_url never stored. Retention terms UNVERIFIED (VI-CQ-02).
rows.title: TikTok: counts kept; ids 30-day refresh-or-delete; cover image never stored

rows.statement: Instagram media insights kept as YouTube statistics; media id, permalink and caption 30-day refresh-or-delete. Retention terms UNVERIFIED (VI-CQ-02).
rows.title: Instagram: insights kept; media id, permalink and caption 30-day refresh-or-delete

rows.statement: X public/non-public metric values kept as YouTube statistics. Retention terms UNVERIFIED (VI-CQ-02).
rows.title: X: metric values kept as statistics

rows.statement: OAuth tokens, refresh tokens, authorization codes, client secrets and PKCE verifiers exist only inside the vault port and never appear in any output.
rows.title: Tokens only in the vault; never output

rows.statement: A clipper who has not connected the posting account through OAuth cannot be certified.
rows.title: Not connected: not payable

rows.statement: Snapchat and Twitch are not payable; X is payable only when VI_PLATFORM_X_ENABLED=1; Instagram requires a professional account with at least 100 followers.
rows.title: Snapchat and Twitch not payable; X only when enabled

rows.statement: An Instagram Collab co-post (or a post whose collab status is unknown) is not certifiable unless the campaign permits collabs.
rows.title: Instagram Collab co-posts not certifiable unless the campaign permits

rows.statement: V&I attests only submissions registered by Creative whose post_ref, platform, posted_at and ids match the registration.
rows.title: Only registered submissions whose facts match are attested

rows.statement: When a Compliance row a V&I rule cites is not verified/in force, or a dependency is unavailable or a stand-in, the ruling is negative.
rows.title: A cited Compliance row or a dependency not in force or unavailable: negative

rows.statement: copyright_strike is false only when the clip was live every day to min_live_end, Legal 37's takedown intake answered with none, and no rights restriction came back; Andre must rule whether this basis suffices (until then this rule is unverified and the answer is true).
rows.title: copyright_strike answered false only on the §C.4.3 basis

spec: Verification and Integrity locked build spec rev 1 (Sep 26, 2026) section B.6
